headline: Sensex and Nifty Volatile as PB Fintech Plummets and Rising Bond Yields Pressure Markets

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Elevated global bond yields and rising crude oil prices are weighing on domestic investor sentiment.
Broad-based caution as every second Nifty 500 stock is trading lower in 2026 despite previous gains.
A significant 36% crash in PB Fintech shares has rattled market confidence in the fintech sector.
Mixed global cues, including concerns over AI-related debt risks and rising yields in US and Japanese markets.
whatHappening: The Nifty 50 is trading around the 23,050 level after giving up its early morning rebound gains.
PB Fintech shares experienced a 36% bloodbath, though Jefferies remains bullish on the Policybazaar parent.
The ArMee Infotech IPO has entered its third day of bidding with a subscription level of 1.17x.
Nomura has initiated coverage on Meesho with a 'Reduce' call, warning of a potential 28% downside.
summary: The Indian stock market is witnessing high volatility as the Nifty 500 faces a correction after years of multibagger returns. While the Sensex and Nifty opened with minor gains, they have struggled to hold levels due to rising oil prices and a sharp sell-off in PB Fintech. Global headwinds, particularly from rising bond yields, continue to keep investors cautious.
